_note: The second half of the chassis pair. 157:169 repeats 157:2's frame exactly
— same header, same 44 progress block, same 28 sent line, same 40 Compare
block, same dense secondary — so where the two agree they settle the panel.
This recipe re-measures those and adds what only this board draws: the
expanded rounds list and the read-only note.
The board's own annotation node (1753:8430) says it: 'Rounds list only —
comments carry no round id (contracts §6.4), so a per-round comment view is
not buildable without a schema change. This board drew one; the code
renders these seven lines at 12/400.' A designer annotation is not
conformed (the 164:22 ledger ruling), but it IS the adjudication, and it
adjudicates to the code.
WHAT MOVED:
· The rounds list was `px-4 py-2 gap-1` over auto-height lines. 1753:8422
is a 24px pitch inset 12 (which is what puts 1753:8423 at 256 in a 280
panel), so the rows are their own 24-tall block inside the strip.
· `Older rounds are read-only.` (157:219/157:220) was not built at all.
It is the sentence that turns a list you cannot click into a deliberate
limit, and the code's constraint is exactly what it states.
· The round LINES. 1753:8423-8429 read "Round 6 · approved 3d ago": the
outcome, then a relative age — the scale the rest of this panel already
uses ("Sent 2d ago · Sara"). They shipped as "Round 6 · Approved by Sara
· 9/5/2026", so one panel spoke in both "2d ago" and a locale date, and
repeated a name that is on the line above. Found by `check-board-copy`,
not by `diff` — no property class covers text. The revocation suffix
stays: outcome over revocation is a code contract (a revoked link does
not undo an approval), and the board has no round that is both.
NOTE the checker still lists these lines as leads after the fix — the
live line is four text nodes ("Round", "approved", "3d", "ago") and it
compares whole nodes. Read `measured/*.json` `rendered` to settle it.
NOT anchored, and why:
157:169 root — transparent panel root, the 164:22 ruling (see the
detached-present recipe).
1753:8422 POSITION — the board draws the expanded list directly under the
progress bar, ABOVE the sent line, while the strip that toggles it sits
at the foot. The code opens it under its own toggle. A disclosure that
opens 600px away from its control is not a layout this measures.
1753:8422 height 176 IS anchored, and it is 7 rows × 24 + 8: the pitch is
the only way the spec expresses row height, since 1753:8423 carries
nothing but its width. The probe renders the board's seven rounds.
157:207 Round history (h70) and 157:214 Re-send (h44) — see the
detached-present recipe; 70 is unexplained on both boards and the
re-send block also carries `Revoke link`, which 158:105/158:162 require.
229:1104 Re-send fill — `--flowbite/blue/600`, against the product's one
accent #1A56DB. Label only. Same call as 157:2.
1753:8430 — the designer annotation itself.
